title: ISO 11136:2014 Sensory analysis: hedonic tests with consumers in a controlled area
claims_supported: Controlled consumer liking; ad libitum intake outside scope; standard current after 2025 confirmation
limitations: Public scope and preview only; not a claim of full-standard compliance

title: The effect of attribute questions on overall liking ratings
publisher: Food Quality and Preference / Popper et al.
claims_supported: JAR attribute questions altered liking ratings; motivates separate preference pass
limitations: Not an RTD study; placing overall liking first alone may not eliminate carryover bias

title: The effect of consumption volume on profile and liking of oral nutritional supplements of varied sweetness
publisher: Food Quality and Preference / Methven et al.
geographic_scope: UK; nutritional drinks; older volunteers and patients
claims_supported: Certain mouthfeel and metallic attributes accumulated over consumption; motivates full-serving checks
limitations: Different matrix and ages; no prediction of a clear functional RTD result

title: The effects of temperature and concentration on the perceived intensity and quality of carbonation
claims_supported: Cooling increased oral irritation; control temperature and CO2
limitations: Abstract/indexed text; not evidence for Czech consumer carbonation preference or proposed 8C setting

title: EFSA explains risk assessment: Caffeine
claims_supported: 200mg single and 400mg/day no-concern adult levels from all sources; 100mg may affect sleep near bedtime
limitations: Not recommended intake or individual guarantee; restrictions and all actives still reviewed
